reel: You're paying for nine apps that have free, open source twins on GitHub.
One. Open Higgsfield. A full AI video studio. Bring your own keys, skip the subscription.
Two. Voicebox. Clone a voice and make narration on your own computer. Bye bye, ElevenLabs.
Three. Open SEO. Rank tracking, backlinks and site audits, without the SEMrush bill.
Four. AppFlowy. Notion style docs and wikis, with AI that runs locally.
Five. Open Whisper. Just talk, and it types into any app. Even offline.
Six. OpenProject. Boards, timelines and tasks. Everything you pay Asana for.
Seven. Cal dot DIY. Your own booking page, just like Calendly.
Eight. Chatwoot. Every customer message in one inbox. Intercom, for free.
Nine. Cap. Record your screen and share a link, just like Loom.
I checked the code of every single one for scams. Follow, and I'll show you how to set them up.
horror: At three in the morning, on an empty street, a man danced toward me. He was smiling the whole time. And he never once looked away. A few years ago, I couldn't sleep. So I started walking. The city at night was the only place my head went quiet.
